description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

The Opportunity

Are you a C# engineer who enjoys building reliable, high-performance software and is excited about the possibilities of AI?

We’re looking for a Software Engineer II – AI & C# to join our team and help build and enhance PDI’s market-leading POS and back-office solutions. This role is a great opportunity for an experienced software engineer who has strong C#/.NET fundamentals and wants to expand their hands-on experience with artificial intelligence.

You do not need prior production AI experience. We’re looking for solid engineering skills, curiosity, and a desire to learn.

You’ll work as part of an agile engineering team designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise software while helping introduce practical AI capabilities into our products. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product owners, UX, QA, SRE, and operations to deliver scalable solutions that solve real business problems.

What You'll Do

  • Build C#/.NET applications: Design, develop, test, and maintain features across our POS and back-office applications, including APIs, services, and SQL-backed data layers.
  • Bring AI into our products: Help integrate capabilities such as LLM-powered assistants, intelligent search, and AI-driven reporting and insights into existing platforms.
  • Develop your AI expertise: Gain practical experience working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), helping move successful prototypes into production.
  • Support AI quality and safety: Develop test cases, evaluate AI outputs, and help identify accuracy, privacy, security, and payment-data considerations before solutions reach customers.
  • Use AI to engineer smarter: Leverage AI coding assistants responsibly to improve development productivity and code quality while sharing effective practices with the broader team.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Operations to translate retail and fuel workflows into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.
  • Own your work: Take features from design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Mentor others: Support junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.Contribute to the Agile team: Participate in Scrum ceremonies, planning, estimation, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Keep learning: Stay current with evolving development frameworks, cloud technologies, and AI tools and apply what you learn to real customer problems.

    • What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of software development experience in a software product development environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET, including ASP.NET Core and Web APIs.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, preferably SQL Server.
  • Exposure to AI/ML concepts through professional experience, coursework, certifications, or personal projects.
  • Some experience experimenting with technologies such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or other LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or generative AI tools. Production AI experience is not required.
  • Experience with Git, Postman, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar development tools.
  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile development practices.
  • Familiarity with at least one public cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments, including PowerShell and bash.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to work through complex technical challenges.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and a willingness to collaborate, mentor, and share knowledge.
  • A self-motivated, curious mindset with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

    • Nice to Have

    Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

  • Angular or other modern JavaScript frameworks
  • Python
  • Delphi
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Embeddings and vector databases
  • AI evaluation or testing frameworks
  • Retail or convenience-store technology
  • Point-of-sale (POS) systems
  • Payments, EMV, or PCI environments
  • Forecourt/fuel systems
  • Wholesale or logistics technologies

    • This is an opportunity to build on your existing software engineering experience while developing skills in one of the fastest-moving areas of technology. You’ll have the chance to experiment with AI, learn from experienced engineers and architects, and turn new ideas into features that solve real problems for PDI customers.

    You don’t need to come in as an AI expert. Bring your C#/.NET expertise, engineering mindset, and curiosity. We’ll give you the opportunity to grow the rest.


    PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.
